desc: The Most Prolific And Reliable Shotgun In The World Is Also The Most Versatile Shotgun Platform Available, With A Model To Fit Every Season, Every Application, And Every User. FEATURES: Dual extractors, positive steel to steel lockup, twin action bars, and an anti-jam elevator ensure smooth operation. Top mounted safety provides for ambidextrous operation. Select models offer the revolutionary Lightning Pump Action (LPA) adjustable trigger.
